measurement.completed_window: preprocess + inputs_set + blocking run + outputs_get/validate + decode/copy owned tuples + release + sample bookkeeping
measurement.contention: viewer unchanged; concurrent NPU users may contend
measurement.cpu_scope: calling thread only; excludes runtime worker threads and device execution
measurement.cpu_unavailable_representation: JSON null / empty CSV numeric field
measurement.excluded: disk reads, hashes, initialization, warm completions, comparisons, sink, file/console writes, context destruction
measurement.fps_denominator: steady_clock first timed completion start through final owned result, release and stored sample
measurement.legacy_exact_sigmoid_fields: protocol aliases for selected-contract exact scalar parity; consult settings.scalar_contract
measurement.preprocess: cached original BGR -> bilinear rounded RGB640 centered letterbox fill114

settings.score_contract: production first-scale class0 heuristic; raw or sigmoid affine values
settings.sort_contract: production scale encounter order and both score-only sorts
